title: unified-rollouts-canary-ab-shadow-autorollback-workflow-improvements
author: Samir Patel
description: Context: Customers running progressive rollouts were observing noisy autorollback triggers on short-lived metric spikes and during staged probing windows. Motivation: reduce false-positive rollbacks while retaining fast automatic protection for regressions, and improve observability for rollback decisions. This PR introduces enhancements to the autorollback workflow: 1) composite-metric decisions: supports weighted composite metrics (latency+error+quality) with configurable thresholds; 2) quorum-based probing: when probing multi-region or multi-variant traffic we require a metric quorum across probes before triggering rollback; 3) staged-quarantine: can quarantine a canary stage and continue probing smaller traffic slices instead of full rollback; 4) stability guards: add short-term smoothing and minimum sample windows to avoid reacting to single-batch anomalies; 5) observability: surface decision traces and contributing metrics in the Console and add rollback reason tags to traces; 6) e2e tests: add canary stability tests covering probing, quarantine, and recovery flows; 7) schema bump and migration: rollouts config schema v2 with backward-compatible defaults and a migration guide. Checklist: - [x] Design doc linked (ENG-3921) - [x] Unit tests for decision engine - [x] E2E stability harness updates - [x] Console dashboard panels for rollback tracing - [x] Migration guide and docs - [x] QA signoff on staging. Backwards compatibility: defaults preserve previous behavior unless new fields are set; operators can opt-in to composite/quorum behavior. Impact: reduces unnecessary rollbacks for noisy workloads, improves signal fidelity for real regressions, and provides richer visibility for SREs and platform teams.
